LXCat-compatible analytic table generated from the published Tabata-Shirai fit.
Generated on 17 July 2026 for the D2 PANTERA case.

RECOMMENDED REFERENCE FORMAT
- T. Tabata and T. Shirai, Atomic Data and Nuclear Data Tables 76, 1-25 (2000).
  DOI: 10.1006/adnd.2000.0835

CROSS SECTION DATA FORMAT
The table contains projectile laboratory energy and cross section.
The H+ + H2 analytic fit is used as the D+ + D2 isotope proxy, consistently
with the other heavy-particle channels in this case. No amplitude or hidden
energy scaling is applied.
